method: AI-assisted paraphrase beside KJV/NIV/ESV/NLT; labeled 'paraphrase (AI-assisted), not a translation'; toggleable

pairs.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
pairs.genz: God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son — so anyone who believes in Him won't be lost, but gets eternal life for real.

pairs.kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
pairs.genz: I can handle what God puts in front of me because Christ gives me the strength — no cap.

pairs.kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
pairs.genz: Trust God with your whole heart and stop trying to figure everything out alone. Bring Him into every decision, and He'll guide your next steps.

pairs.kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
pairs.genz: God's saying: I've got plans for you — good plans, not wrecking you — plans that give you a real future and hope.

pairs.kjv: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
pairs.genz: The Lord is my shepherd. With Him, I'm not missing what I actually need.

pairs.kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
pairs.genz: Don't be afraid — I'm with you. Don't spiral — I'm your God. I'll strengthen you, help you, and hold you up.

pairs.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
pairs.genz: We know God can work even the messy stuff together for good for people who love Him and are living in His purpose.

pairs.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
pairs.genz: Come to Me, everyone who's exhausted and carrying too much — I'll give you rest.

pairs.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
pairs.genz: Don't spiral over everything. Talk to God about it — pray, ask, and say thank you. His peace, which doesn't even make sense, will guard your heart and mind in Jesus.

pairs.kjv: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
pairs.genz: God's already told you: be strong and courageous. Don't freeze in fear — the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.
